verdict.rationale: Docusign CLM covers drafting with dynamic templates and AI clause drafting, plus drag-and-drop contract process design for a controlled workflow. AI-Assisted Review redlines against playbooks inside MS Word, and real-time commenting supports collaboration. missing for 10: explicit evidence of counterparty negotiation and redline-exchange workflow (version control, tracked-change round-trips), detailed docs beyond marketing claims, independent or hands-on corroboration.
